messages:
melody-ops: Heads-up — planned switchover for Mossbridge onto Dedicated slice `moss-ded-07` on 2026-03-24 22:00 UTC. Requesting final go/no-go and pin to serving image model-serving:v3.2.1-quant. @samira-se @jordan-sre

samira-se: I can be on call. Are we doing staged traffic shift?

melody-ops: Yes — plan: 10% -> 50% after 15m -> 100% after 30m if metrics stable. Canary will use existing config except GPU type bumped to a100-80gb.

jordan-sre: Monitoring checklist: latency p95, 4xx/5xx, token cost delta, and KV cache hit rate. Link: https://console.redwood.example.com/dashboards/mossbridge-slice

melody-ops: Rollback criteria proposal: revert if 5m error rate >2% OR p95 latency increases by >200ms vs baseline for 10m. Also auto-fallback to model-serving:v3.1.8 if model errors spike. Thoughts?

anna-prod: +1 on criteria. Add a manual hold if business-facing error is seen even below threshold. Mossbridge wants notification before full 100% cutover.

raj-srv: infra note — quota has a hard limit at 320 vcores for the slice. Autoscaler will not exceed that during burst; should be fine for their expected load. Confirming snapshots and backups scheduled at 21:00 UTC same day.

melody-ops: Good. I'll pin the release artifacts now: image=model-serving:v3.2.1-quant, infra-template=dedicated-v2.4.4, rollout-id=rb-2340000123.

deploybot: [deploybot] Canary deploy started for rollout rb-2340000123 at 2026-03-24T22:00:00Z. Canary slice: moss-ded-07-canary.

melody-ops: Canary to 10% initiated. Ops will watch first 15m.

deploybot: [deploybot] Canary reports: boot ok, agent logs healthy. p95 latency: 240ms (baseline 215ms), errors 0.3%. KV cache hit 78%.

jordan-sre: Looks okay. Keep an eye on tail latency. I'll run synthetic traffic ramp for 10m.

samira-se: If nothing odd in 15m, proceed to 50%. Please ping Mossbridge slack channel before 50% shift.

melody-ops: Acknowledged — will ping. Also adding note to release notes: pinned model-serving:v3.2.1-quant (quantized weights), expect ~1.2x token-cost improvement.

deploybot: [deploybot] Rollout to 50% at 2026-03-24T22:15:00Z completed. Metrics: p95 260ms, errors 0.6%, cost delta -18%.

anna-prod: Noted. Mossbridge ops told me they're ready for 100% after 30m if stable.

melody-ops: Final gate — any objections to 100% at 22:30?

jordan-sre: No objections from infra side. I'll keep SRE watch for next 30m.

samira-se: No objections. Proceed.

melody-ops: Proceeding to 100% now. Sending notification to mossbridge-ops channel. :rocket:

deploybot: [deploybot] Cutover to 100% completed at 2026-03-24T22:31:10Z. rollout rb-2340000123 is active.

melody-ops: Post-cutover checks: running smoke evals and verifying embedding consistency. If we see quiet regressions, we'll schedule a rolling-revert to v3.1.8.

raj-srv: Snapshot verified post-cutover. No infra alerts.

melody-ops: Thanks team. I'll close this thread after 24h of stable metrics and add short release note to the Mossbridge account page.

samira-se: Thx — marking oncall as covered.

jordan-sre: Great work.
